title: Update to Filing Location for U Nonimmigrant-Based Form I-485
paragraphs: U nonimmigrants applying to become lawful permanent residents must now fileForm I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, only at the Nebraska Service Center and not at the Vermont Service Center.
We have updated the filing address on theDirect Filing Addresses for Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, page.

Applications filed at the Vermont Service Center must be postmarked on or before April 12, 2023. After that date, we will reject and return any application, secure identity documents, and other correspondence to the safe address, preferred address, or the address of the attorney or accredited representative if any is listed on an accompanying Form G-28.
